title: 私のファーストライブ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon's birthday performance is coming up, and the two of us are working on a special video for her fans.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh my gosh, this cake is so cute! ♪ No wonder it made the Umamusume Top 100 Desserts list. ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Well, I need to keep up with what's trending, so a little treat before lunch couldn't hurt. ☆ Ooh, lemme snap a pic for Umasta real quick. ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: …Huh? Where's my phone? It should be in my bag! Wait, seriously, where'd it go?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The video is made up of rare snippets of Smart Falcon's day-to-day life. Her terrible organizational skills are part of her charm.
choice_data_list: I'd say it's looking pretty good!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it's great, but… ehhh…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: It just, it seems no different than a usual video. But this is for my once-a-year birthday performance. It should feel special.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I want my fans to really get to know me! That way, I can feel closer to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She wants to show a side of herself she's never shown before. It might be time to recruit the help of the person who knows her best.
choice_data_list: Why don't we try talking to your parents?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That could work! ♪ I'll ask them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon asks her parents for advice and gets a response almost immediately.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh, they sent a video too! I wonder what it is? Let's watch it together, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: …Oh, it looks like it's one of our holiday home movies. That must mean this little girl is—

text_block_list.name: Young Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna give you lotsa, lotsa love. ♪ Smoochies! ☆

text_block_list.name: Falcon's Mother
text_block_list.text: You are just too cute! One more time! Encore! ☆

text_block_list.name: Young Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. ♪ Smooch, smooch, smooch! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The little Smart Falcon blows kisses at the camera. Over and over and over…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Nooooo, turn it off! What the—Dad, why do you have this?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: My fans have definitely not seen anything like this, so it's special in that sense, but…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ack, stop it! You're making me b-blush…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Huh? They sent another video. And this one's got a message.

text_block_list.name: Falcon's Father
text_block_list.text: What do you think? Pretty good camerawork, if I do say so myself. And there's plenty more where that came from!

text_block_list.name: Falcon's Father
text_block_list.text: Your eyes would light up whenever we complimented you, then you'd do it over and over… It really takes me back.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hehe. That's right…

text_block_list.name: Falcon's Father
text_block_list.text: This is a video of that time you started singing while we were out shopping. We didn't get up to much shopping that day, hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh, I don't remember that… Sounds like me, though. Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: My parents were always happy to see me sing, and I loved seeing their reactions.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: And it didn't stop with my parents. The folks down at the shopping district, my friends… I loved all their smiles!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That little performance was the beginning… the start of my dream.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: All right. It's a little embarrassing, but I think this video should be played at my birthday concert!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I want everyone to know how my dream began!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: …Oh, I know! I'll top things off by singing the same song in the video. ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Everyone will be so happy to see how much I've grown! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon, giddy with childlike delight, hops her way to practice!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh, my dad sent me something again! He said, "I've got plenty of videos in the vault, need some more?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hmm, if we get too many they won't feel as special. I'll tell him to save them for another time! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon pushes on with her birthday concert preparations, anticipating the day more of her treasured home videos come to light!
